title: Migrate SOA auxiliary calls to GPT-5.6 and refine date-filter handling
summary: Sales Order Agent upgrades auxiliary model calls from GPT-4.1 to GPT-5.6 Ceres and refines item-search date-filter handling to better use system-generated availability dates when no customer delivery date applies.
key_points: Migrate message and attachment relevance checks, email-template validation, and signature insertion to use GPT-5.6 Ceres instead of GPT-4.1
Simplify item-search date-filter logic to accept page default availability period when no delivery date is requested or dates are in the past
Prevent system-generated availability dates from appearing in customer-requested delivery dates
Clear date filters once and accept resulting defaults instead of repeatedly rechecking
Model results may differ with GPT-5.6 Ceres requiring evaluation and validation of various date scenarios
